scientific_limitations: Exact results concern the nilpotent chain evolution algebra with unit superdiagonal, not arbitrary maximal-nilindex evolution algebras.
The generator-tuple probability is for field-linear automorphisms, not semilinear maps.
An unlocated general scalar-semidirect-product random-generation theorem might imply part of the counting formula; external publication-priority review remains open.
title: Random generator spectra of automorphism groups of nilpotent chain evolution algebras
